rationale: Bill is building real-time AI perception and LLM efficiency at General Instinct, focusing on sparse attention, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and online RL from user feedback—areas where Jiale's deep expertise in ML infrastructure, distributed training systems, and scalable platforms at Meta could be directly valuable. Jiale's transition from low-level systems work to AI-focused roles positions him well to understand both the research and production challenges Bill is tackling.
intro_message: Bill Jiao, meet Jiale Zhi — Jiale's experience building scalable ML infrastructure at Meta could help inform the systems-level decisions you're making around LLM efficiency and real-time perception at General Instinct.
